# How to Trim Video with Claude MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to cut a video to a specified time range, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_trim_video`

## Prompt

```text
Cut a video to a specified time range.
```

## Review before approval

- `input_file_id` (required): Input video file id.
- `start_time` (optional): e.g. 00:00:05.
- `end_time` (optional): e.g. 00:00:30.
- `duration` (optional): e.g. 00:00:25. At least one of start time/end time/duration required.
- `model_id` (optional): Model Default: trim-video-default.
- `title` (optional): Optional task title.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
